name: B10-0049/2024 (ECR) – The case of José Daniel Ferrier García in Cuba
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of José Daniel Ferrer García, a Cuban opposition leader held in solitary confinement since 2021. It condemns human rights abuses in Cuba and the growing number of political prisoners. It asks the European Union to stop funding or giving concessions through Cuban government institutions, and to require three conditions before any economic relations resume: freeing all political prisoners, guaranteeing free expression and peaceful assembly, and holding a binding vote on a move to multi-party democracy. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament only states demands and conditions.
- **Who it affects:** Cuba's government and people, and European Union dealings with Cuba.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Cuba's government and National Assembly; no action is binding.
